dogecoin.text:
The team behind meme-based crypto project Floki Inu ($FLOKI), which is one of the strongest competitors to Dogecoin and Shiba Inu, is soon airing a 15-second TV commercial that highlights some of the most bullish achievements of the project.
#floki #BSC

As reported by https://t.co/TESlZJjQSc, the company enabled support for Shiba Inu earlier this month to the great delight of the community. Prior to that, it added rival meme cryptocurrency Dogecoin. Last September, it enabled Ethereum purchases.
